remedies.title: Soil corrections
remedies.lowPhosphorusAction: Use SSP/DAP according to the local soil-test dose and band it near the root zone. Re-test before adding more.
remedies.acidicSoilAction: pH 6.5 is acceptable for wheat. If the selected crop needs neutral soil, use only a lab-calculated lime dose and re-test after incorporation.
remedies.balancedAction: Maintain organic matter and verify nutrient levels with the next scheduled soil test.
